body:
23 Nov 2026, THE FIRST CHECK OF THE PAIR ON A REAL PHONE (the lead; the owner, AFK, said: install the APK on the real phone and test things around). PAIR: server image sha-27d4383 (the merge of #118), deployed on VM 108 by `encore update` after a copy of its database (schema 18; key repair 40 of 3,314 keys; worklist 0; rekey audit PASS; local/homelab-changes-2026-11-23.md entries 1 and 2) + APK build 161 of the SAME commit (arm64 release; the same signing certificate as build 160, SHA-256 070b04bd...8e12 on both; installed over build 160 with adb install -r --user 0: the session and the data survived, nothing uninstalled) on the Samsung A35 (RFCX8184C2V).
CHECKED, with the evidence: P1-07 a search for an artist and for a song shows ONE 'Top result' card at the top. N-21 the Top result of a song search (a library song) opens the full song menu with its three-dot button and with a long press; swipe right shows 'Add to queue'; swipe left likes it (the menu then says 'Remove from Liked Songs'; undone at once: 'Removed from Liked Songs'). N-22 tapping the open tab again: Search (results -> Recent searches), Your Library (Liked Songs -> Your Library), Home (the Liked Songs tile -> Home). N-20 OFFLINE (wifi and data off and VERIFIED: wifi_on=0, ping to the server and to the Internet 'Network is unreachable'): a tap on the downloaded song, and the audio system reports a started AudioTrack of the app 234, 375 and 384 ms later (3 runs). N-19 OFFLINE the same way: Pause in the full player: the control becomes Play, the session is PAUSED, no 'no connection' text appeared at once or 4 s later. N-39 (part): the question before Remove on the '00s Hip Hop download (188 of 189 songs, 769.7 MB): 'Remove ... from this phone? The 188 songs ... are deleted ...' with Cancel and Remove; Cancel changed nothing. The song that failed says why in words (the only copy on YouTube needs an age check). The phone's network was restored (the server answers a ping).
WHAT THIS IS NOT: nothing is marked WALKED. The definition of pass needs the published image installed BY THE GUIDE on a CLEAN machine; VM 108 is an updated install with the owner's data, so these rows stay 'built, not walked'. This is the first real-phone evidence that they behave on the pair. NOT DONE: N-11 (one song, one entry) was not walked; N-39's Stop in the middle of a download, the app swiped away while stopped, and Resume were not walked (every download on the phone was already finished); the rehome had nothing to do on this server (worklist 0), so its first run on real data has NOT been seen. A MISTAKE OF MINE, corrected: my first offline attempt was not offline (a shell trap put the network back when its command ended); the numbers above are from the second, verified run. B-138 (refmerge on dead file rows) still needs a board item.
